item.title: Bulletin updated at 03:15 HKT 30/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will moderate slightly today and tomorrow, but the weather will still be cool in the morning over the coast of Guangdong. Daytime temperatures will rise slightly. A fresh easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. It will be mild during the day over the region. Meanwhile, an area of low pressure will affect the southern part of the South China Sea. The associated band of clouds will cover the northern part of the South China Sea during the period. Under the influence of another surge of the northeast monsoon, the weather will be cool in the morning and at night over the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week to early next week. It will be fine and dry during the day.
